observation.command: grep -rhoE "inspireplu[a-z]*|<ServiceName>[^<]*|xplaninspireplu[a-z]*" /opt/deegree/xplan-webservices-inspireplu-workspace/services/*.xml 2>/dev/null | sort -u; echo "=== deegree theme service refs ==="; grep -rhoE "service[^ ]*\.xml|viewservice|downloadservice" /opt/deegree/xplan-webservices-inspireplu-workspace/themes/inspireplu.xml 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== try inspirepluwfs/inspirepluwms ==="; for u in "inspirepluwms?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities" "inspirepluwfs?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities" "viewservice?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities" "downloadservice?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities"; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 40 "http://localhost:8080/xplan-webservices-inspireplu/services/$u"); echo "$code  $u"; done
